title: Dashboard snapshot
description: The aggregates-only snapshot.json that scripts/lanes/snapshot.mjs builds and .github/workflows/dashboard.yml publishes to GitHub Pages (ADR 0012). Numbers, titles, stages, check and reviewer names and times only: no logins, emails, bodies or comments. contracts.test.mjs checks a built snapshot against this file field by field.

generatedAt.description: When the snapshot was built, as a UTC ISO 8601 time. The page shows it, since scheduled runs can be late.

issues.description: Every open task issue (one with a tier label) and every open issue a pull request closes.

title.description: The issue title, control characters removed and cut to 200 characters. GitHub-sourced text: render it as text, never as HTML.

tier.description: The issue's tier label, or unknown when it has none.

stage.description: status.mjs's stage vocabulary for an issue with a pull request; ready, blocked, not-ready and already met for one without. running is an open issue with the lane:running label and no pull request yet (ADR 0014).

blockedBy.description: What holds the issue or its pull request up. reason is the lanes/gate description verbatim for gate waits.

ref.description: An issue as #N, a check or reviewer by name, or the merge queue.

pr.description: The open pull request that closes the issue, when there is one.

criteria.description: Per acceptance criterion, from the reviewers' verdicts on the pull request's current head: fail if any reviewer failed it, else pass if any passed it, else not-applicable.

edges.description: Each "Blocked by" link between two listed issues: from blocks to.

overlaps.description: Every pair of open ready or running issues whose Scope paths overlap (soft paths excluded), the check pick.mjs and status.mjs run (ADR 0014). a < b, so a pair appears once; contracts.test.mjs enforces the order, which a schema cannot. No file path is published. Optional until snapshot.mjs emits it.
